query: How does driving a vehicle in the right gear impact fuel efficiency and emissions?
reference_answer: Driving the vehicle in the right gear will increase fuel efficiency and reduce emissions.
context:
[Document 1]
Driving the vehicle in the right gear will increase fuel efficiency and reduce emissions.

[Document 2]
Avoid dragging the engine by using the correct gear.

answer: Driving in the right gear increases fuel efficiency and reduces emissions [Document 1]. It also helps avoid overworking the engine, which can lower fuel consumption and decrease emissions [Document 2].
